paragraphs: The F-Pace P400e is Jaguar's plug-in hybrid variant of the F-Pace SUV, introduced in 2020 as part of the X761 generation. The petrol engine is the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder — which works alongside an electric motor to produce 404PS combined. The P400e offers an electric-only range of 33 miles per Jaguar's own specification. The P400e sits alongside the rest of the F-Pace range as Jaguar's petrol PHEV offering, distinct from the diesel and supercharged V8 variants in the lineup. No PHEV-specific known issues have been confirmed for this variant at this time. Jaguar F-Pace P400e Engine Compatibility Because the F-Pace P400e uses a specific Ingenium 2.0-litre petrol engine paired with an electric motor, parts and service requirements differ from the standard petrol and diesel F-Pace variants. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace P400e from 2023 to present. The AJ200P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.
